title: Midea UZ21 — Test mode entry
description: Enter test mode for forced cooling and defrost per §9.7.

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press LOCK + − together 3 s — LED shows 0. Auto-exits after 30 s idle. Press + once → forced cooling (1). Press Vacation → forced defrost (3). LOCK + − 3 s again to exit.
